youtube.title: Why Airplane Wings Curl Up at the Tips ✈️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Those upturned tips are called winglets. Air under a wing is under higher pressure and tries to spill around the tip, forming a swirling wingtip vortex that creates drag. Winglets, developed by NASA engineer Richard Whitcomb, block some of that spill and cut drag, saving airlines millions in fuel.
